question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

BAWP, ?, DWCH, EUFD, FSIZ
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and third letters → (1) and (3) are added to the position value according to English alphabetic series respectively.
 
• Second and fourth letters → (2) and (4) are subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series respectively.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5431977ed95a3ba35d43a1ed38d718f954bdc288b537b9ea2f23c0f6db69fa39.png] ​

​Hence, "**CYZL**" is the correct answer.
